events.title: Diplomacy tolls at Hormuz as conflict returns to its doorstep
events.summary: The fragile truce between Tehran and Washington expires on April 22. With it ends restraint. Conflict will return, though its scale remains uncertain.

events.title: Opposition to US talks grows in Tehran as ceasefire deadline nears
events.summary: Mounting opposition to negotiations with Washington in Tehran is casting doubt over whether Iran will proceed with a new round of talks with the United States in Islamabad as the ceasefire deadline approaches.

events.title: Disrupting Procurement Networks Supporting Iran’s Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and Ballistic Missile Programs and Mahan Air
events.summary: Thomas "Tommy" Pigott, Principal Deputy Spokesperson  Press Statement April 21, 2026 Today, the United States is imposing sanctions on eight individuals and four entities that operate multiple procurement networks supporting Iran’s UAV and ballistic missile programs and U.S.-designated Mahan Air. events.title: Tehran moderates see ‘no deal–no war’ limbo as worst outcome
events.summary: Tehran’s commentariat is warning that the most troubling outcome of the current negotiations with Washington may be neither war nor peace, but a prolonged “no deal–no war” limbo.

events.title: The future has been switched off here
events.summary: I am online again after 51 days. It is difficult to describe what things feel like here in Tehran. Bad is not quite the word. Weird, perhaps. Unreal.

events.title: Top condom maker plans price hikes of up to 30% amid US-Iran war impact
events.summary: Malaysia’s Karex Bhd, the world’s largest condom producer, plans to raise prices by 20% to 30% and possibly more if supply chain disruptions linked to the Iran war persist, its chief executive told Reuters.

events.title: Family told missing teen was alive, then received his body 60 days later
events.summary: A 14-year-old student disappeared during protests near Tehran on January 8, only for his family to receive his body 60 days later with a gunshot wound to the temple, Iran International has learned.

events.title: Lights out, then gunfire: Witnesses recount Mashhad protest crackdown
events.summary: A 32-year-old protester in Mashhad, northeastern Iran, stood in the street as the lights flickered out and the mobile network went dead, believing he had only a one-in-five chance of making it out alive.

events.title: Scam messages seek crypto for ships’ safe passage through Hormuz, firm warns
events.summary: Fraudulent messages offering ships safe passage through the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for cryptocurrency have been sent to some shipping companies, Reuters reported on Tuesday, citing a maritime security firm.

events.title: Iran executes man as January protest crackdown continues
events.summary: Iran executed a man on Tuesday over accusations that he set fire to a mosque and what authorities described as anti-security activities, according to the judiciary, in a case tied to anti-establishment protests earlier this year.

events.title: Is Iran entering its Gorbachev moment?
events.summary: The idea of an “Iranian Gorbachev” has surfaced before in the Islamic Republic, but this time the conditions may be different.

events.title: Iran crackdown reaches cemeteries as graves of slain protesters defaced
events.summary: Iranian authorities have stepped up pressure on families of those killed in January protests, defacing, destroying or covering graves with cement in the northern city of Rasht and the capital Tehran, local sources told Iran International.

events.title: Iran diplomacy wobbles as factions compete to avoid looking soft on US
events.summary: Apparent divisions over negotiations with the United States may have strengthened the most confrontational elements within Iran’s political landscape and facilitated the rise of new hardline actors.

events.title: Israel: Military Alliances
events.summary: To ask the Secretary of State for Defence, if he will review the 2020 military cooperation agreement with Israel in the context of that country’s role in the war on Iran since 28 February 2026.

details.question_text: To ask the Secretary of State for Defence, if he will review the 2020 military cooperation agreement with Israel in the context of that country’s role in the war on Iran since 28 February 2026.
details.answer_text: A UK-Israel military cooperation agreement, which incorporates a range of defence engagement activity, was signed in December 2020. Whilst the UK Ministry of Defence regularly reviews cooperation with Israel, the agreement remains extant.
